prompt: A 2 floor house with 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a study and parking on an 18 x 24 m plot. Put living and dining toward the rear for privacy, and keep the study near the front.

labels.text: FRONT / SOUTH - 6 m assumed front zone
FRONT / SOUTH - 6 m assumed front zone

assumptions: 2 floor(s); rectangular plot; south/front entrance. Room counts are totals across floors.
Assumed front zone 6 m; sides/rear 1.2 m. These are not local regulations.
1.2 m corridor; 0.9 m room door openings; 0.15 m schematic walls. Room areas exclude schematic wall faces.
Stairs are aligned schematic reservations; rise/run, structure and vertical clearance are not validated.
Furniture, parking and window symbols are illustrative. No egress, accessibility, daylight, MEP or code-compliance approval.
Local mode reads dimensions, total room counts, 1–3 floors, study/office, utility/laundry and parking.
Defaults: 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 1 floor. Other preferences, including entrance orientation and individual room dimensions, are not applied.
AI chose room sides, order, depths and corridor split; rectangular envelope, assigned floors and full-depth corridor remain constrained.
Left column width set to 6.0 m and right column to 8.4 m for balanced room widths.
Stairs placed on the left side (Side 0) at y=16.0 with height 4.0 m to align across both floors.
Living and dining grouped at the rear of the right column for privacy, with the kitchen adjacent to the dining area.
Office (study) placed at the front of the left column to satisfy the front-facing preference.
Flexible spaces utilized to fill remaining gaps and maintain perfect tiling on both floors.
checks: Required rooms preserved on assigned floors
No room gaps or overlaps within 1 mm tolerance
Minimum column widths and room depths checked
Continuous 1.2 m corridor with room openings
